validated_variants.grounding_summary: The Abarth 500 was officially imported to Israel. However, the provided trim string 'Competizione / Scorpione / Nuvolari S' combines three technically distinct trims. Competizione is a high-performance trim (up to 180hp), Scorpione was the entry-level trim (135-145hp), and Nuvolari S replaced the Scorpione as the entry-level trim with 165hp. Because these trims have different power outputs and specifications, they must be split into separate variants. The petrol model's production ended around 2024, replaced by the electric 500e.
